title: plugin-auth SSO: a SAML account_not_linked refusal redirects to the success callbackURL and ignores errorCallbackURL (OIDC honours it)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a contract gap with a named consumer**. The cloud#3666 dev measured it with offline mock OIDC and SAML IdPs driving a real licensed objectos-ee serve (report 6687166444 on objectstack-ai/cloud#3666; draft PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3673; repro in `apps/objectos-ee/test/sso-mock-idp.e2e.test.ts`). Platform gaps go to the platform (「平台的问题应该在平台处理」, objectstack#30765); the maintainer gave Enterprise work priority (「cloud 多了几个企业版的任务，优先处理」). Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3666 (Enterprise SSO with Okta / Entra ID).

## 维护者速读

用 SAML 登录、但对应账号不允许关联时，平台会把用户跳回「登录成功」的页面，只在网址后面挂一个错误参数，而不是跳到错误页。用户会看到一个似乎登录了、其实没登录的页面。OIDC 在同样的情况下是正确跳到错误页的，SAML 应该和它一样。

## Measured (cloud pin `2ffdb649` on the serve)

- SAML ACS, account-not-linked refusal → `302` to the SUCCESS `callbackURL` with `?error=account_not_linked`; `errorCallbackURL` is ignored.
- OIDC callback, same refusal → `302` to `errorCallbackURL`.

## Expected

- The SAML ACS sends every refusal to `errorCallbackURL` when one is given, as the OIDC callback does. If the cause is upstream (`@better-auth/sso`), the lane patches it or wraps the ACS, and says which.

## Acceptance

- Tests: the SAML takeover case lands on `errorCallbackURL`, and a success still lands on `callbackURL`.

Suggested-grade: p2.

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `account_not_linked errorCallbackURL` → 0. None.
